items.title_zh: [GitHub] 纯 Rust NeuroRVQ 推理项目
bullets_zh: GitHub 项目 Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs 提供纯 Rust 的 NeuroRVQ 推理，用于对 EEG、ECG 和 EMG 信号进行分词。
它使用 Burn 0.20 且无 Python 依赖，可实现轻量级 Rust 原生生理信号处理流程。
这与非侵入式 BCI 预处理相关，因为它面向 EEG 等表面生理信号。
bullets_en: GitHub project Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs provides pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference for tokenizing EEG, ECG, and EMG signals.
It uses Burn 0.20 with zero Python dependencies, enabling lightweight Rust-native biosignal processing pipelines.
This is relevant to non-invasive BCI preprocessing because it targets surface physiological signals such as EEG.
items.brief: 纯 Rust EEG/ECG/EMG 分词推理，便于轻量部署。
items.brief_en: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference for EEG/ECG/EMG tokenization, enabling lightweight deployment.
items.raw_excerpt: Build pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with Burn 0.20 and zero Python dependencies

items.title_zh: LE-VAI/access-input：支持EEG的辅助输入抽象库
items.title_en: LE-VAI/access-input: EEG-Agnostic Assistive Input Abstraction Library
bullets_zh: GitHub项目LE-VAI/access-input为辅助访问提供输入抽象层，包括自适应停留和开关扫描。
它对注视/EMG/EEG无关，因此与集成非侵入式基于EEG的BCI信号相关。
发布于2026-09-28；MIT许可且零依赖，降低开发者采用门槛。
bullets_en: GitHub project LE-VAI/access-input provides an input abstraction layer for assistive access, including adaptive dwell and switch scanning.
It is gaze/EMG/EEG-agnostic, making it relevant to integrating non-invasive EEG-based BCI signals.
Published 2026-09-28; MIT licensed with zero dependencies, lowering adoption barriers for developers.
items.brief: 开源MIT输入抽象库，支持注视、EMG和EEG源用于辅助访问。
items.brief_en: Open-source MIT input abstraction library supporting gaze, EMG, and EEG sources for assistive access.
items.raw_excerpt: Input abstraction for assistive access: adaptive dwell, switch scanning, and gaze/EMG/EEG-agnostic sources. Zero dependencies, MIT.
